:"SYS_B_070")<>:"SYS_B_071" AND NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_072")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_073") <> :"SYS_B_074" AND (NVL(FACCINT, :"SYS_B_075")=:"SYS_B_076" OR NVL(FAFTMATINT, :"SYS_B_077")=:"SYS_B_078") AND NVL(FPSTAC, :"SYS_B_079")=:"SYS_B_080" ) WHERE DRCR = DECODE(NVL(:"SYS_B_081", :"SYS_B_082"), :"SYS_B_083", DRCR, :"SYS_B_084", :"SYS_B_085", :"SYS_B_086", :"SYS_B_087") UNION ALL SELECT A.ENT_DATE AS :"SYS_B_104") < :"SYS_B_105" AND (NVL(FACCINT, :"SYS_B_106")=:"SYS_B_107" OR NVL(FAFTMATINT, :"SYS_B_108")=:"SYS_B_109") UNION ALL SELECT A.ENT_DATE AS TDATE, OTRNNO AS TRN_NO, B.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_NO, fdcytjj3g2a2xINSERT INTO GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN6 (GMST_CODE, OTHGMST, NRECNO, FORM60_61) SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE AS GMST_CODE, C.GMST_CODE AS OTHGMST, B.NRECNO, C.FRM60_61 FROM GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN7 A, BANKMAS C , GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN5 B WHERE :"SYS_B_00"=:"SYS_B_01" AND A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND ( ( ( DECODE(NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_02"), :"SYS_B_03", LTRIM(RTRIM(LPAD(NVL(UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO))), TO_CHAR(NVL(C.LINKGMST, C.GMST_CODE))), :"SYS_B_04", :"SYS_B_05"))), LTRIM(RTRIM(LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(NVL(C.LINKGMST, C.GMST_CODE)), UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO)))), :"SYS_B_06", :"SYS_B_07"))) ) = LTRIM(RTRIM(A.SRCHGRPID)) ) OR ( UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO))) IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(C.PANNO)))= LTRIM(RTRIM(A.SRCHPANID)) ) ) ) UNION SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE AS GMST_CODE, C.GMST_CODE AS OTHGMST, B.NRECNO, C.FRM60_61 FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.GMST_CODE, NVL(B.LINKGMST, B.GMST_CODE) AS SRCHLINKGMST FROM BANKMAS B, GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN7 A WHERE NVL(B.PANNO(+), :"SYS_B_08") = NVL(A.SRCHPANID, :"SYS_B_09") AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(B.PANNO(+)))) IS NOT NULL AND NVL(B.LINKGMST(+), :"SYS_B_10") !=:"SYS_B_11" AND NVL(B.LINKGMST(+), B.GMST_CODE(+)) != A.GMST_CODE ) A, BANKMAS C , GLBKARV.TMPFRMTRN5 B WHERE :"SYS_B_12"=:"SYS_B_13" AND A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND ( NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_14")= NVL(A.SRCHLINKGMST, :"SYS_B_15") AND NVL(C.LINKGMST, :"SYS_B_16")<>:"SYS_B_17" )
fkszph40q7xknINSERT INTO GLBTMPACBK (TDATE, AC_NO, DRCR, CSH_TRN, PRTCLS, DEBIT, CREDIT, BALANCE, DOC_NO, ACMASTCODE, PASS, POST, CTRNNO, OTRNNO, VOU_NO, VOU_SRNO, OP_ID , SU_ID, RC_COUNT, FD_COUNT, CHQ_PREFIX, CASHIER_ID, CASHIER_OK, CASH_CR, CASH_DR, CSHR_EXCP, DENMTION , REF_ACNO, REF_ACMCD , CHQBOUNCE, FORBRANCH, ATBRANCH, VOU_GRNO , DD_GRNO, GOLD_REC_NO, DD_CLEAR, INTFRDT, INTTODT, AC_TYPE, RECEIPTNO, FD_RC_CNT , SHIFT_NO, PROC_SRNO, AC_CODE, TRNSCNID) SELECT A.TDATE, A.AC_NO, A.DRCR, A.CSH_TRN, A.PRTCLS, A.DEBIT, A.CREDIT, A.BALANCE, A.DOC_NO, A.ACMASTCODE, :"SYS_B_00", A.POST, A.CTRNNO, A.OTRNNO, A.VOU_NO, A.VOU_SRNO, A.OP_ID , A.SU_ID, A.RC_COUNT, A.FD_COUNT, A.CHQ_PREFIX, A.CASHIER_ID, A.CASHIER_OK, A.CASH_CR, A.CASH_DR, A.CSHR_EXCP, A.DENMTION , A.REF_ACNO, A.REF_ACMCD , A.CHQBOUNCE, A.FORBRANCH, A.ATBRANCH, A.VOU_GRNO , A.DD_GRNO, A.GOLD_REC_NO, A.DD_CLEAR, A.INTFRDT, A.INTTODT, A.AC_TYPE, A.RECEIPTNO, A.FD_RC_CNT , A.SHIFT_NO, A.PROC_SRNO, B.AC_CODE, A.TRNSCNID FROM ACBK A, ACMAST B WHERE A.ACMASTCODE=B.ACMASTCODE AND A.TDATE = :"SYS_B_01" AND ATBRANCH = :"SYS_B_02" AND NVL(A.CNCLED, :"SYS_B_03") !=:"SYS_B_04" AND A.TRN_TYPE = :"SYS_B_05" AND A.CSH_TRN!= :"SYS_B_06" AND NVL(A.SSD_QUICK, :"SYS_B_07")=:"SYS_B_08" AND NVL(A.SRCOFTRN, :"SYS_B_09") NOT IN (:"SYS_B_10", :"SYS_B_11", :"SYS_B_12") AND NVL(A.POST, :"SYS_B_13")<>:"SYS_B_14" ORDER BY VOU_GRNO, OTRNNO

Finding 1: Session Connect and Disconnect
Impact is .89 active sessions, 18.37% of total activity.
--------------------------------------------------------
Session connect and disconnect calls were consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .89 active sessions, 18.37% of total activity.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate application logic for possible reduction of connect and
      disconnect calls. For example, you might use a connection pool scheme in
      the middle tier.

statements offer a good opportunity for performance improvement.

Finding 3: Soft Parse
Impact is .41 active sessions, 10.24% of total activity.
--------------------------------------------------------
Soft parsing of SQL statements was consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .41 active sessions, 10.24% of total activity.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate application logic to keep open the frequently used cursors.
      Note that cursors are closed by both cursor close calls and session
      disconnects.

   Recommendation 2: Database Configuration
   Estimated benefit is .41 active sessions, 10.24% of total activity.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Consider increasing the session cursor cache size by increasing the
      value of parameter "session_cached_cursors".
   Rationale
      The value of parameter "session_cached_cursors" was "1000" during the
      analysis period.


Finding 4: Hard Parse Due to Invalidations
Impact is .23 active sessions, 5.67% of total activity.
-------------------------------------------------------
Cursors were getting invalidated due to DDL operations. This resulted in
additional hard parses which were consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .23 active sessions, 5.67% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate appropriateness of DDL operations.

   Symptoms That Led to the Finding:
   ---------------------------------
      Hard parsing of SQL statements was consuming significant database time.
      Impact is .37 active sessions, 9.29% of total activity.
